name: Tape Series — Dated Labels, Two Initials
vera_note: Fourteen tapes, spanning about eight months. The initials on the labels are the same throughout: T.V. I have processed four. I am cataloguing them as a series. The rest I will do slowly.

echo.output: Single voice throughout all recovered segments. Female-presenting, older. Speaking conversationally, as if to a listener — but no second voice detected. Reconstructed excerpt, tape 3: 'They keep saying it was an accident. Nobody built an accident that large. Someone decided something, somewhere. I just don't know if the someone was a person.' Tape 7: 'My son thinks I'm wrong. He says I shouldn't give machines that much credit. I told him I wasn't giving credit. I was giving responsibility. He didn't like that.' Tape 11: 'I think I've been trying to find a villain. I think that was the wrong project.' [recording ends]

glean.confident_output: Personal diary recordings. Individual testimony, non-official. No corroborating documents.
glean.actual_output: Personal audio diary, ongoing series. Speaker T.V., consistent identity across tapes. References: newspaper headlines (non-recoverable), a son (unnamed), a professional role ('back when I worked on the infrastructure side'). The recordings span a period beginning before major disruptions and continuing through them. Tape 14 label date is consistent with the final weeks of documented communications. The recording on tape 14 has not yet been processed.

verification_result: T.V. worked in infrastructure. The recordings are a continuous witness account, not a debrief. She was watching events happen in real time and talking herself through them alone in a sealed room. The fourteenth tape is here. I am leaving it for now.
